notes: Hand translations (unverified) patched into cache/translate for ca1b, e027, 3843, e538; originals kept as .bak-pre-sa-homeless. Audio offsets measured by envelope cross-correlation: C0484 = VID059 + 2.19s, C0485 = VID059 - 85.00s.

TAKING HIM - the real walk to the stall (Sony, backs) over its own synced chest-cam audio: "Let's eat something. Do you like kebab? Pita kebab? Come, come."

'As a kid I thought everything he did was against me. I used to rebel.'
local-3843b9158bfb6eb6

"I've been feeling lonely lately. There was the war and all of that. You don't have anyone to talk to, brother." The line the whole film is about.
local-e538e7e17faec033
